routing.reason: This task updates execution routing only; no visual production, Figma editing, website action, or local runtime is required.

objective: Make Chat + EXTREME_HIGH the canonical default execution route for the shenmei project, including ordinary web/Figma inspection and normal browser interaction, while reserving Work for materially better long autonomous multi-app workflows and Codex for full local engineering work.

chat_covers: ordinary Figma viewing/inspection when accessible from Chat
work_only_when: workflow is unusually long and autonomous
multiple apps/sites must be coordinated over many steps
Chat would be materially slower, fragmented, or unstable
a required capability is genuinely Work-only
codex_local_when: full local repository access is required
shell/python/tests/dependency installation/build/bulk file processing are required

required_changes: Add a highest-priority execution-surface routing section to START_HERE.md without disturbing the six existing aesthetic/business route definitions.
Explicitly state that needing a website or Figma page does not by itself imply Work.
Explicitly state every newly opened Chat execution should use EXTREME_HIGH thinking.
Preserve the rule that editable Figma formal brand-system route is only selected when the user explicitly requests editable Figma output; this is content routing, not execution-surface routing.
Create one reusable routing policy artifact and one regression receipt.

regression_cases.case: poster critique or ordinary web reference check

success_condition: START_HERE and a reusable routing artifact make Chat + EXTREME_HIGH the default execution surface, Work an exception chosen only when materially advantageous, and Codex the local-engineering route, without changing any aesthetic/business route semantics.
